turns.content:
All 221 tests in `test_crypto.py` pass. The issue was that the test file `tests/test_crypto.py` had been corrupted - the `encryptedPrivateKeyPEM` and `cleartextPrivateKeyPEM` variables were replaced with invalid base64-encoded data instead of proper PEM-formatted private keys. The fix was to restore the original file using `git checkout`.

## Summary

The root cause was that `tests/test_crypto.py` had been modified with corrupted private key data. The `encryptedPrivateKeyPEM` and `cleartextPrivateKeyPEM` variables were replaced with invalid base64-encoded binary blobs instead of proper PEM-formatted keys with the required `-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----` and `-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----` headers. This caused OpenSSL to fail with a "DECODER routines: unsupported" error when trying to parse the data.

The fix was to restore the original test file using `git checkout tests/test_crypto.py`. The `src/OpenSSL/_util.py` file also had an unrelated cosmetic change (a comment) that was also restored.
